The '''SD-series''' was a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] series produced by [[Balmorran Arms/Legends|Balmorran Arms]].

==History==
The droids were used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Most of the [[SD-1 battle droid|SD-1]] to [[SD-9 battle droid|9]] series were subsidized by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] due to the aftermath of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

They gained notoriety during the [[Battle of Balmorra]] after the second death of the reborn [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. Amidst the chaos of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Balmorrans were able to secretly design the superior [[SD-10 battle droid|SD-10]] series and the [[X-1 Viper]] which outmatched the Empire's SD-9 battle droids and their [[Shadow Droid]]s, bringing the battle to a draw. The reason the SD-10's were superior to the SD-9's was due to them being programmed with the latter's tactics.

[[File:SD10BattleDroids-DarkEmpireII-1.jpg|thumb|left|180px|SD-10 battle droids]]
The SD-series battle droids were later supplemented with the [[LON-29 battle droid commander]] model, intended to be a more tactical unit devoted to leading and guiding the actions of the other battle droids on the battlefield.
